class.name: NNBTCompositeNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree composite nodes.
class.description: A composite node groups any number of behaviour tree children and decides which of them to tick. Composites accept any number of children and never report a runtime error for their child structure. When a composite has no enabled behaviour tree children the editor shows a configuration warning, because such a node cannot do any work. The runtime identity results are unchanged: an empty or fully disabled sequence succeeds, while an empty or fully disabled selector fails.
